title: Doctor
line: Check why a tool is missing from a Pi session.

beats.caption: You run a read-only health check.
Doctor finds tools this session cannot reach.
beats.label: pi-doctor

beats.caption: The report says which tools are unreachable.

takeaway.title: Trace the missing tool
takeaway.line: Check how it is registered and how the session can reach it.

title.text: If a tool seems to be missing, slash doctor can tell you what pi sees in the current session.

scene.text: The report lists the installed versions and tool registry. Here it finds deferred tools, but tool search is inactive. That gives you something specific to check in your settings.

takeaway.text: You can use the report to guide the fix. It reads the session and configuration without changing them.
